data.name: Dharamnishth
data.gender_notes: Dharamnishth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is established in righteousness and duty. The name Dharamnishth carries the meaning “Dharma (duty, ethics) Nishtha (established, firm)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dharamnishth usually hope their child will grow to embody dharma (duty, ethics) nishtha (established, firm) and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Dharamnishth belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dharma (duty, ethics) Nishtha (established, firm).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dharamnishth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Dharamnishth" holds immense cultural significance in Hindu society as it embodies the qualities of righteousness, duty, and morality. In Hinduism, following Dharma, which means righteous duty or moral order, is considered a fundamental aspect of leading a virtuous life. The person named Dharamnishth is perceived as someone upholding these values and therefore inspiring others around him to do the same. This name conveys a sense of tradition, stability, and moral strength in a social context.
data.spiritual_significance: At the core of the name "Dharamnishth" lies its deeper spiritual significance. Dharma is a concept deeply rooted in Hinduism, denoting the moral principles and duties upheld by an individual. Nishtha, on the other hand, means establishment, steadiness, or deep-rootedness. Thus, the name Dharamnishth signifies a person who is deeply rooted in his Dharma, living a life according to his moral duty and Principles, and ultimately, striving towards spiritual growth and enlightenment. It is an inspiring identity embraced by those who aspire to lead a blessed, virtuous life, rooted in the wisdom of tradition and dissolving in timeless spiritual understanding.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dharamnishth: One firmly rooted in Dharma (cosmic law, moral principles). A beacon of righteousness and virtuous living, inspiring others to follow the path of truth and justice.
